description: Suijin OS v7.3.0 — The Anywhere Release. The box works for everyone, everywhere: OrbStack on macOS and Docker on every other platform at full parity (platform-aware detection, one-time arrow-key picker, optional pinned docker contexts with daemon transparency), bring-your-own-container via `suijin box adopt` (provisions into an operator's container, never deletes it), `suijin box shell` for instant bash, tools on PATH in every shell, clean row-by-row install streaming, and host trust anchors for TLS-filtered networks. Field-hardened the same week: provider-failover errors name the whole chain, transport blunts get real backoff, sessions tear down their background machinery, pauses are silent, the knowledge graph is workspace-first with a neutral in-tree seed, and a standing no-hardcode guard keeps secrets, engagement data and machine paths out of the tree.
